name: miracosta-monitor
description: Tokyo DisneySea Hotel MiraCosta availability monitor with LINE notification (personal use)

scripts.setup: npm run build && node dist/index.js setup
scripts.check: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js check
scripts.monitor: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js monitor
scripts.capture: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js capture
scripts.test-line: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js test-line
scripts.status: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js status
scripts.history: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js history
